verdicts.reason: A leaves a huge dead blue void between the subcopy and the CTA, reduces the ocean photo to an unreadable sliver at the bottom with a stray white line, and pushes the logo to the right while the text is left-aligned, so nothing shares an axis. B also cuts the photo down to thin strips at the top and bottom and centres the logo over left-aligned text, and its headline and copy sit tight to the edges, but the larger headline and evenly spaced stack fill the tall format with a clear headline-to-CTA reading order.
